_comment: What each destination will not admit, and WHY -- because the reason is the
feature. WORLD.md: 'the validation checklist teaches each world's rule before
arrival.' A crossing that answered 'no' would be a locked door. A crossing that
answers 'no note blocks, the Quiet One's crossing is silent' has taught a world's
law before the player has seen a single block of it.
So every rule is chosen to be LEGIBLE rather than merely restrictive. Each one is
the god's law applied to your luggage, and a player who reads it understands what
the Quiet One  -- a thing that CAN sound, will. Silence is not a preference.
the Anchorite  -- unanchored things rise. Bring nothing that pours.
the Verdant    -- you brought something you stripped and killed.
the Hearth-Turner -- you brought something you stopped from ageing. To a god
whose law is keeping every past, wax is the insult.
Only the Quiet One's rule is specified in WORLD.md; the other three are derived
from each god's locked law and grief-shape. Names in the letters are Rill,
Ballast and Ash -- see WORLD.md, 'The pantheon'.
